**Date:** {{< meta display-date >}}  
**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

My dear [Maggie](../persons.html#83)
What a great day to have your birthday upon.

You cannot look to many returns of Holy Thursday upon it, so this will be all the more to remember, but I wish you many, many more happy returns.

Thank you and [Mamma](../persons.html#1019) for your curl. I shall have quite enough now I send you one of the brooches made to a pattern of Mary Queen of Scots which I saw at Edinburgh last year and thought you would like as it makes your M and is historical.
your affectionate godmother
CMY

[^1]: Black-edged paper.

We have not been able to discover a reason why CMY used black-edged paper for this letter and the two following dated 3 June and 11 June.
